info.name: PureCloud Platform Billing API
info.description:
With the PureCloud Platform API, you can control all aspects of your PureCloud environment. With the APIs you can access the system configuration, manage conversations and more.

Contact Support:
 Name: PureCloud Developer Evangelists
 Email: DeveloperEvangelists@genesys.com

item.name: Get a report of the billable license usages

query.description: (Required) The period start date. Date time is represented as an ISO-8601 string. For example: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss[.mmm]Z
(Required) The period end date. Date time is represented as an ISO-8601 string. For example: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss[.mmm]Z

request.description: Report is of the billable usages (e.g. licenses and devices utilized) for a given period. If response's status is InProgress, wait a few seconds, then try the same request again.

item.name: Get the billing overview for an organization that is managed by a partner

query.description: 0 for active period (overview data may change until period closes). 1 for prior completed billing period. 2 for two billing cycles prior, and so on.

variable.description: (Required) The organization ID of the trustor (customer) organization.

request.description: Tax Disclaimer: Prices returned by this API do not include applicable taxes. It is the responsibility of the customer to pay all taxes that are appropriate in their jurisdiction. See the PureCloud API Documentation in the Developer Center for more information about this API: https://developer.mypurecloud.com/api/rest/v2/

response.name: successful operation

query.description: 0 for active period (overview data may change until period closes). 1 for prior completed billing period. 2 for two billing cycles prior, and so on.
